definitions.explanation: Items that can be eaten, especially commercially produced or processed foods.

notes:
{食品|しょくひん} emphasizes food as a product or commodity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{冷凍|れいとう}{食品|しょくひん}→冷凍食品：06075_reitoushokuhin⟧ (frozen food)
- ⟦{加工|かこう}{食品|しょくひん}→加工食品：06605_kakoushokuhin⟧ (processed food)
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}{食品|しょくひん}→健康食品：17355_kenkoushokuhin⟧ (health food)
- ⟦{食品|しょくひん}{添加|てんか}{物|ぶつ}→食品添加物：25624_shokuhintenkabutsu⟧ (food additives)
- {食品|しょくひん}⟦{衛生|えいせい}→衛生：14049_eisei⟧ (food hygiene)
- {食品|しょくひん}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧ (food section)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {食品|しょくひん}: food as a product/commodity
- ⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧: food (general, what you eat)
- ⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧: food supplies
